title: Four things the agent must always know.

cards.title: Goal
cards.body: Outcome plus observable completion checks, not a vague wish.

cards.title: Evidence
cards.body: Facts with sources: tool output, records, prior approvals.

cards.title: Budget
cards.body: Remaining turns, time, and which writes still need a human.

cards.title: Recovery
cards.body: Missing info, bad args, denied permission, or external fault.
